description: This file defines a class MoveToDebugManifestQuickFix that implements an Android lint quick fix to move a permission declaration from a non-debug manifest to a debug-specific manifest in an Android project.

classes.name: MoveToDebugManifestQuickFix
classes.description: Implements a quick fix to move a permission declaration to a debug-specific manifest in Android projects.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes the quick fix by removing the permission from the current manifest and adding it to a debug-specific manifest.

methods.name: addManifest
methods.description: Creates or updates the debug-specific manifest file to include the mock location permission.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves the module associated with a given PSI element.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Determines if the quick fix is applicable in the current context.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the quick fix action.
